youtube_short.title: The $35K 529 Loophole Nobody Tells You About
title_alternatives: Leftover 529 Money? Here's the Escape Hatch
SECURE 2.0 Changed 529 Rules — Did You Know?
youtube_short.description: If your kid got a scholarship or just didn't use all their 529 money, most parents assume it's stuck — spend it on education or pay a 10% penalty. But SECURE 2.0 changed everything in 2024. You can now roll up to $35,000 of unused 529 funds directly into a Roth IRA, completely tax-free. Three rules: the account must be 15 years old, max $7,000 per year, $35,000 lifetime cap. That $35K in a Roth at 25 grows to $533,000 tax-free by retirement. 90% of 529 owners have no idea this even exists. Follow for more money moves they never taught you. #personalfinance #money #529 #rothira #taxhack
